goals.description: Retrieve and open the mushroom packages.
goals.rationale: The person gathers the packets of mushrooms and opens the packaging to access them.

goals.description: Transfer mushrooms to a colander and wash them.
goals.rationale: The person tips the mushrooms into a colander, rinses them under running water, and shakes off the excess water.

goals.description: Slice and chop the first batch of washed mushrooms.
goals.rationale: The person takes the first few mushrooms from the colander, slices them, chops them into smaller pieces, and transfers them to a tray.

goals.description: Slice and chop the second batch of washed mushrooms.
goals.rationale: The person continues taking mushrooms from the colander, slicing and chopping them, and scooping them into the tray.

goals.description: Slice and chop the third batch of washed mushrooms.
goals.rationale: The person repeats the process of slicing, chopping, and transferring more mushrooms from the colander to the tray.

goals.description: Slice and chop the fourth batch of washed mushrooms.
goals.rationale: The person slices and chops another set of mushrooms from the colander.

goals.description: Slice, chop, and transfer the final batch of washed mushrooms.
goals.rationale: The person finishes the remaining mushrooms in the colander, inspecting them, chopping them finely, and placing them into the tray.

goals.description: Open and prepare the next tray of mushrooms for chopping.
goals.rationale: The person opens a new tray of mushrooms, moves the chopped mushrooms out of the way, and prepares the new batch on the chopping board.

goals.description: Slice and chop the second tray of mushrooms.
goals.rationale: The person slices and chops the mushrooms from the newly opened tray and transfers them to the collection tray.
